ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a square with side length 6, with 6 marked on the top side; a horizontal dashed line connects the midpoints of the left and right sides. Point A is on the left side of the dashed line, and point B is on the right side of the dashed line. A solid line goes from the lower-left vertex through A to the upper-right vertex, and another solid line goes from the lower-left vertex through B to the upper-right vertex, dividing the square into three regions. Reasoning: Establish a coordinate system, let the lower-left vertex be (0,0), and the upper-right vertex be (6,6), so the midline is y=3. Let A=(a,3), B=(b,3). For any point P=(x,3) on the midline, the area below the broken-line path from (0,0) to P and then to (6,6) is: the area of the left triangle (1/2)x·3, plus the area of the right trapezoid ((3+6)/2)(6-x), namely 1.5x+4.5(6-x)=27-3x. Therefore the area above this path is 36-(27-3x)=9+3x. The three parts have equal areas, and each part has area 36/3=12. The upper outside region corresponding to A has area 12, so 9+3a=12, giving a=1. The lower outside region corresponding to B has area 12, so 27-3b=12, giving b=5. Therefore AB=b-a=5-1=4.

method.method_draft: Inspect the figure as a square of side 6 with a horizontal dashed midline through A and B, A to the left of B. The drawn broken lines are from the bottom-left vertex through A or B to the opposite top-right vertex, creating a top-left outer region, a middle region, and a bottom-right outer region. Put coordinates on the square: bottom-left vertex (0,0), top-right vertex (6,6), so the midline is y=3. Let A=(a,3) and B=(b,3). For a point P=(x,3), the path from (0,0) to P to (6,6) has area below it equal to the sum of a triangle and a trapezoid: (1/2)x·3 + ((3+6)/2)(6-x)=27-3x, so the area above it is 36-(27-3x)=9+3x. Since the upper outer region above the A-path is one of the three equal parts, set 9+3a=12 to get a=1. Since the lower outer region below the B-path is one of the three equal parts, set 27-3b=12 to get b=5. Therefore AB=b-a=5-1=4.
